City of Encinitas
Commission for the Arts
AGENDA
OCTOBER 1, 2018 -
5:00
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS None
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Commission for the Arts. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES Approve the September 10, 2018, special meeting minutes.
Agenda Item 7A. September 10, 2018 Special Meeting Minutes
8.
ACTION ITEMS
8A.
Commission for the Arts Work Plan. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam.
Review FY 2018-19 Commission Work Plan and vote as needed.
Agenda Item 8A. Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan
9.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
9A.
October Commission Calendar. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam.
1.
Public Art Applicant Workshop, Oct. 3, 6 p.m., Encinitas Library
2.
Orpheus Sculpture Unveiling, Oct. 6, 10 a.m., K Street Parkway
3.
Wednesdays@Noon: Oct. 3, 10, 17, 24 and 31, Encinitas Library
4.
Music By The Sea: Duo Sopranos, Oct. 19, 7:30 p.m., Encinitas Library
5.
Encinitas Dia de los Muertos, Oct. 27, 12-4 p.m., Encinitas Community Center
9B.
Public Art Report. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam.
9C.
Encinitas Friends of the Arts Report. Contact Person: Commissioner Sabeck.
9D.
Cultural Arts Division Report. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam.
10.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
11.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Future agenda items may be request with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
12.
COMMISSIONERS’ REPORTS
ADJOURNMENT
The next Commission for the Arts meeting will be held on November 5, 2018.
